dominant_strengths: Confident oversized headline with tight tracking creates a strong, memorable verbal hook anchoring the hero
Monochromatic purple gradient with soft 3D blobs delivers a cohesive, on-brand atmospheric mood
Clear primary/secondary CTA hierarchy and clean nav typography keep behavioral path obvious
dominant_weaknesses: Hero is generic SaaS template — purple gradient + blobs + bold serif-ish sans is a worn 2022 pattern
Product screenshot floats awkwardly at the fold cut, lacking framing, shadow craft, or narrative connection to the headline
Tab row (Design/Collaborate/Pitch/Analyze) sits visually detached, weak contrast against gradient reduces scannability
fix_priorities: Differentiate hero with a more distinctive visual concept than generic gradient blobs to escape SaaS sameness
Integrate the product UI screenshot with deliberate framing, perspective, or annotation tying it to the headline claim
Strengthen the feature tab strip with better contrast, separators, or active-state treatment for legibility
Tighten vertical rhythm — headline-to-subhead-to-CTA spacing feels loose and unbalanced against the screenshot
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral pull from color and type is solid, behavioral clarity is decent, but reflective distinctiveness is low — it looks like every other AI deck tool.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes, it functions as a Pitch SaaS landing page and communicates the AI presentation value prop, but without a memorable signature.
